assessment.nobel_worthiness: Turns the ubiquitin-proteasome system into a defined chemical tool: bifunctional and monovalent degraders hijack E3 ligases to eliminate chosen proteins. Mechanistically clear, general for biologists, and now clinically consequential.
assessment.attribution: PROTAC concept and first proof from Crews and Deshaies; the thalidomide-cereblon mechanism (Handa and colleagues) explains molecular glues. Ciulli (VHL ligands), Sakamoto, Gray and others are also strong, so the three-person limit forces a contestable choice.
assessment.maturity: Concept dates to ~2001 and has been reproduced independently by many groups; clinical degraders are in late-stage trials, so timing is good though clinical proof is still maturing.
uncertainties: Credit split between PROTAC inventors, cereblon mechanism discoverers and ligase-ligand developers is unresolved.
Whether a compound discovery spanning PROTACs and molecular glues needs separate recognition.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Showed that the mutant cysteine of KRAS G12C can be covalently targeted, breaking the belief that RAS was undruggable. A clean chemical-reactivity idea with large medical consequences and a template for covalent drugging.
assessment.attribution: Single credited name; the decisive tethering and switch-II pocket work came from the Shokat lab, though drug development involved industrial teams not credited here.
assessment.maturity: Independently validated by approved drugs (sotorasib, adagrasib) and widespread follow-on work; recognition is timely.
uncertainties: Industrial contributors to approved compounds are outside the supplied credit.
I am not independently verifying clinical details.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Base editors use engineered deaminase chemistry to convert one base into another without double-strand breaks, a precise molecular tool for biologists with clear therapeutic relevance, grounded in nucleotide chemistry.
assessment.attribution: Liu lab made the decisive cytosine and adenine base editors, with Komor and Gaudelli as lead authors; Nishida and Kondo made an independent deaminase-fusion editor, so credit is not fully unambiguous.
assessment.maturity: Rapidly reproduced across many labs and organisms, with first clinical uses; the early stage of therapy makes long-term outcomes uncertain but the tool is established.
uncertainties: Overlap with prime editing (B041) and CRISPR itself, already recognized, may shape how the committee treats this.
Parallel work by Nishida and Kondo complicates priority.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Ionizable lipid nanoparticles are a chemistry solution to nucleic-acid delivery: pH-dependent charge and lipid design govern encapsulation, endosomal escape and efficacy. Their impact through mRNA vaccines and siRNA drugs is very large.
assessment.attribution: Vancouver work on ionizable lipid formulation and rapid-mixing manufacture is decisive; Anderson, Langer and MacLachlan also contributed key lipids and delivery systems. Credit is distributed.
assessment.maturity: Validated at global scale by approved siRNA and mRNA products; recognition is timely though mRNA-related prizes have recently been given.
uncertainties: Overlap with the 2023 mRNA-vaccine prize may count against recognition.
Allocation among academic and industry contributors is unclear.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Adds new amino acids to the genetic code with orthogonal synthetase/tRNA pairs, giving a general chemical handle for installing new functionality in proteins in living cells.
assessment.attribution: Schultz and Wang established the first in vivo orthogonal pair for an unnatural amino acid; Chin extended it to eukaryotes and to quadruplet and orthogonal ribosome systems. Yokoyama and Mehl are also credited, so the selection is contestable.
assessment.maturity: Widely reproduced and used for over twenty years; mature, though broader impact beyond specialist labs is still growing.
uncertainties: Possible overlap with directed-evolution and phage-display prizes.
Allocation among Schultz, Chin, Wang and Yokoyama.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Nitrogenase is a central enzyme in biological nitrogen fixation; its FeMo-cofactor structure and mechanism reveal the chemistry of N2 reduction. Strong enzymological and structural substance.
assessment.attribution: Rees and Einsle provided structures, including the interstitial carbide; Seefeldt and Dean contributed mechanistic work and Ribbe cofactor biosynthesis. Credit is spread across structural and mechanistic work.
assessment.maturity: Structures are well confirmed, but the substrate-binding mechanism is still incompletely resolved, so recognition could be premature or require a mechanistic breakthrough.
uncertainties: Mechanism of N2 binding and reduction remains debated.
Choice among structural and mechanistic contributors is hard.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Reversible-terminator sequencing-by-synthesis converted nucleotide chemistry into massively parallel DNA reading, transforming biology and medicine.
assessment.attribution: Solexa chemistry by Balasubramanian and Klenerman is central; Rothberg, Mayer and Ju contributed parallel technologies, so a fair prize has competing claims.
assessment.maturity: Thoroughly validated by universal use; maturity high, but the prize may be seen as overdue and the interplay with other sequencing platforms is complex.
uncertainties: Competing claims from pyrosequencing and other platforms.
Whether the committee views this as chemistry or medicine/technology.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Reversible mRNA methylation with writers, erasers and readers reveals a regulatory layer of RNA chemistry with broad biological and disease relevance.
assessment.attribution: He identified FTO as an m6A demethylase and reader function; Rechavi and Jaffrey mapped m6A transcriptome-wide; Jia, Yang and others also contributed. Credit is fragmented.
assessment.maturity: Core concept is reproduced, but quantification, antibody-based mapping artifacts and functional interpretation are still disputed; recognition may be early.
uncertainties: Mapping methods and stoichiometry of m6A have been debated, and I would want stronger independent confirmation.
Attribution among many groups is unresolved.
